evidence.title: Texas think tank accuses Houston parent coalition of using 'socialist' tactics to push radical agenda

occurrences.checkable_against: CVPE public statements and Texas Education Agency takeover records
occurrences.quote_span: CVPE has been an outspoken opponent of the state's 2023 takeover of the Houston Independent School District (HISD)
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: CVPE public platform and campaign materials
occurrences.quote_span: Beyond opposing the state takeover, CVPE advocates against mandatory STAAR testing and urges parents to boycott the exams.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: Fox News interview with Kate Bierly and TPPF report
occurrences.quote_span: "There are several policies that they're advocating for which are questionable at best, but very harmful," Kate Bierly, campaign director for TPPF's Next Generation Texas Campaign, told Fox News Digital.
occurrences.speaker: Kate Bierly
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: Ruth Kravetz statements and HISD STAAR score records
occurrences.quote_span: Kravetz previously challenged the "Texas Miracle" touted by HISD Superintendent Mike Miles and Texas Gov. Greg Abbott, alleging that recent test improvements were artificially-engineered.
occurrences.speaker: Ruth Kravetz
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: Texas Public Policy Foundation report and election records for DSA-endorsed candidates
occurrences.quote_span: The local group, Bierly said, uses tactics similar to those employed by the Democratic Socialists of America (DSA), which has gained traction in recent years as a political force with the election of several DSA-endorsed candidates across various levels of government.
occurrences.speaker: Kate Bierly
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: HISD Algebra I enrollment and course eligibility records
occurrences.quote_span: "The truth is that HISD’s Mike Miles didn’t allow qualified students to even take Algebra I," Kravetz said.
occurrences.speaker: Ruth Kravetz
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: CVPE public statements and advocacy materials
occurrences.quote_span: while CVPE maintains that peaceful advocacy is essential to improving school environments and curricula.
occurrences.speaker: Community Voices for Public Education
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education
occurrences.quote_span: In a report released by the Texas Public Policy Foundation (TPPF), researchers argue that Community Voices for Public Education (CVPE) — which presents itself as a grassroots group of parents, teachers and community members — acts as a front for teachers' unions and far-left organizations working to preserve the status quo.
occurrences.speaker: Texas Public Policy Foundation researchers
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: Texas Public Policy Foundation report and CVPE organizing guidance
occurrences.quote_span: TPPF contends that CVPE actively instructs parents on how to organize student demonstrations outside schools
occurrences.speaker: Texas Public Policy Foundation
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: CVPE platform and public statements
occurrences.quote_span: CVPE defends its platform, maintaining that restorative justice and expanded mental health resources foster safer learning environments than punitive measures, insisting "HISD students should be heard and not herded."
occurrences.speaker: Community Voices for Public Education
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: Ruth Kravetz interview and educational quality research
occurrences.quote_span: "It undermines educational quality," Kravetz said.
occurrences.speaker: Ruth Kravetz
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: HISD student course enrollment records and STAAR results
occurrences.quote_span: This skewed the STAAR results and played a shell game with scores.
occurrences.speaker: Ruth Kravetz
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: CVPE public statements and Texas Education Agency takeover records
occurrences.quote_span: CVPE has been an outspoken opponent of the state's 2023 takeover of the Houston Independent School District (HISD), Texas's largest school district.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: Texas Public Policy Foundation report and CVPE policy materials
occurrences.quote_span: One of the main groups behind these proposals is CVPE."
occurrences.speaker: Kate Bierly
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: Fox News interview with Ruth Kravetz and TPPF report
occurrences.quote_span: Ruth Kravetz, co-founder of CVPE, pushed back on both TPPF’s report and the state's academic claims.
occurrences.speaker: Ruth Kravetz
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: TPPF report and CVPE statements about STAAR testing
occurrences.quote_span: "Some of the things they are advocating for is that parents should boycott the STAAR exam because the test allegedly supports racism and inequality," Bierly added.
occurrences.speaker: Kate Bierly
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: CVPE public platform and campaign materials
occurrences.quote_span: The group also calls for divesting from campus policing — ending student arrests except in severe cases such as murder — and encourages participation in walkouts and political protests.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: Texas Education Agency testing and advanced academic track access records
occurrences.quote_span: "Scrapping this testing removes a key pathway for low-income kids to access advanced academic tracks."
occurrences.speaker: Kate Bierly
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: HISD Algebra I enrollment policies and student opportunity records
occurrences.quote_span: Most importantly, they denied opportunities to countless kids just to make the numbers look better.
occurrences.speaker: Ruth Kravetz
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: Ruth Kravetz interview and student outcome research
occurrences.quote_span: Kravetz also criticized high-stakes standardized testing, arguing that it fails to improve student outcomes.
occurrences.speaker: Ruth Kravetz
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: Fox News Digital correspondence and HISD response records
occurrences.quote_span: HISD did not immediately respond to Fox News Digital's request for comment.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education

occurrences.checkable_against: CVPE membership or supporter records and Ruth Kravetz interview
occurrences.quote_span: "Some of those parents are Republicans. Some are Democrats, some are socialists, and some are unaffiliated," Kravetz said.
occurrences.speaker: Ruth Kravetz
occurrences.subject: Texas Public Policy Foundation report on Community Voices for Public Education
